description: CoeFont API text-to-speech: synthesizes text with any accessible CoeFont voice, selected by its uuid.

meta.language_note: English CoeFonts read English; Chinese CoeFonts read Chinese only
meta.output_delivery: 302 redirect to audio file URL (expires in 7 days)
meta.params: speed (0.1–10), pitch (±3000 cents), volume, kuten/toten pause lengths
meta.phoneme_input: yomi (reading) + accent string, Japanese voices only
meta.plan: API access requires the Plus plan (¥55,000/month tax incl., promotional price); no per-character API price published

name: CoeFont TTS (API v2)
